passes: Inside the camera transform; one function per theme
Per-theme effects and specular text sweeps, still in camera space
Previous frame blended with lighten for light trails
Bright-pass at quarter and twelfth resolution, added back
Radial zoom from the bloom buffer
Bloom multiplied by a dirt texture
Filter grade, soft-light tint and screen lift
Filter runs at render scale .75 or better
Crisp text drawn above the film look
Snapshot of the last beat played out with the theme's transition
DOM chips track the beat and jump on click
governor: Device pixel ratio capped at 1.5; the canvas is capped at 1600 px wide.
Frame time is averaged. Above 26 ms the render scale drops by 18%, with a floor of 50%; under 18 ms it climbs back.
Grade, chromatic aberration and lens dirt run only at render scale .75 or better.
scene_api: draw(s, t, B, dt) { /* one frame */ }
beat_object: B = { i, t, d, p, n, tc, start }: beat index, time in beat, beat duration, progress, beat count, time in cycle, beat start.
stage_object: s = { th, scene, c, cv, k, W, H, R, st, t, lvl, pointer, q, P }: theme, scene, context, canvas, scale, logical size 960 x 540, seeded random, scene state, clock, level, pointer, render scale, post config.
